full_judgment: 3. Relevant facts for disposal of the Rule, in short, are that one Sree Hem Chandra Chakraborty claiming himself as Managing shebait of Sree Sree Dashabhuja Mata Commonly known as Sree Sree Dhakeswari Mata filed Pauper Miscellaneous Case No. 65 of 1963 before the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka impleading himself as plaintiff No. 2 and impleading Sree Sree Dhakeswari Mata as plaintiff No. 1 praying for declaration of title of the deity, for recovery of khas possession, for confirmation of possession and for mesne profit of the lands described in the schedule, of the plaint; that the suit was converted as Title Suit No. 38 of 1964 in the Court of 3rd Subordinate Judge, Dhaka. Thereafter, the suit was transferred to the 5th Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka and was renumbered as Title Suit No. 29 of 1969. Thereafter, the suit was transferred to the 2nd Court of Joint District Judge, Dhaka and was renumbered as Title Suit No. 115 of 1990 and lastly on transfer to the 4th Court of Joint District Judge, Dhaka has been renumbered as Title Suit No. 584 of 2016.
